published_by: Ofgem, Retail Market Indicators: 'Retail price comparison by company and tariff type: Domestic (GB)' (Energylinx to May 2017, Energyhelpline June 2017 - May 2022, Cornwall Insight from June 2022)
what_this_is: THE PUBLISHED RECORD a supplier can read: how far below the default tariff the cheapest deal on the market sat, as a share of the typical default bill, by quarter. It is what a price-match save and a price-matched renewal cut are sized against (company.crm.save_offer.price_match_save_rate). Moved here 2026-10-12 from simulation/save_on_loss_notice.py, where a supplier observable lived in a world file (docs/staging/SEAT_FINDING_THE_SAVE_THE_MOVER_OFFER_AND_THE_PAYMENT_WORK_AGAINST_THE_FOUR_PRINCIPLES_2026-10-11.md section 1 P3 (b)). Values unchanged.

basis.gap_share: (default bill - cheapest tariff (all suppliers)) / default bill, typical consumption. The default is the large-legacy SVT average until 2018 and the cap level from 2019, as the series itself switches.
basis.reading: Each quarter is the quarter's first-month reading. A quarter not listed is not established and reads None, which offers nothing; 0.0 is an established absence of any deal below the default.

series_source: https://app.everviz.com/embed/g53GfRDaf, the data behind the chart on https://www.ofgem.gov.uk/news-and-insight/data/data-portal/retail-market-indicators, fetched 2026-10-10. Derivation and confidence: docs/market_research/cheapest_fix_against_the_default_tariff_gb_2016_2025.md.

source_check.publication: Ofgem, Retail Market Indicators, 'Retail price comparison by company and tariff type: Domestic (GB)' -- the cheapest tariff (all suppliers) against the default tariff, monthly. The data table is served inside the chart's everviz embed, not as a download.
source_check.how_to_recheck: GET https://app.everviz.com/embed/g53GfRDaf and read the CSV string inside the page JSON (the Ofgem portal page itself is JS-rendered and cannot be scraped). Confirm the embed is still the one behind the chart of that title on https://www.ofgem.gov.uk/news-and-insight/data/data-portal/retail-market-indicators via the page's `data-js-chart-modal-data` attributes. The series carries no edition: a revision shows only as a later last month, or as changed values in months already read, so diff the quarter's first-month readings against `quarters` here. Method and the zero quarters: docs/market_research/cheapest_fix_against_the_default_tariff_gb_2016_2025.md.

checked_for_supersession.note: The quarters here ARE the fetch of 2026-10-10, so they agree with the series as served that day by construction. Moved unchanged on 2026-10-12 from the table in simulation/save_on_loss_notice.py; old and new readers agree on every month 2014-2027.
